test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_neutral_values (k UInt64, pnl Nullable(Float64)) ENGINE=MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE perf_neutral_keys (k UInt64, d Float64, PROJECTION p (SELECT k,sum(d) GROUP BY k)) ENGINE=MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE perf_neutral_high (k UInt64, d Float64, PROJECTION p (SELECT k,sum(d) GROUP BY k)) ENGINE=MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE perf_neutral_merge AS perf_neutral_values ENGINE=Merge(currentDatabase(), '^perf_neutral_(values|keys)$')
CREATE TABLE perf_neutral_high_merge AS perf_neutral_values ENGINE=Merge(currentDatabase(), '^perf_neutral_(values|high)$')
CREATE VIEW perf_neutral_view AS SELECT intDiv(k,10) AS k,pnl FROM perf_neutral_merge
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_neutral_values SELECT number%1000,toFloat64(number%100) FROM numbers(10000)
INSERT INTO perf_neutral_keys SELECT number%1000,1 FROM numbers(1000000)
INSERT INTO perf_neutral_high SELECT number,1 FROM numbers(1000000)
